# ButtonGroup
Atlas ButtonGroup v1 — joins related Button actions into one connected control. 2 orientations × 3 sizes (6 total). Items are ButtonGroupButton instances (outline shown); the container sets each item’s Position (left/middle/right, or top/middle/bottom).

When to use — a small set of related actions on the same object: alignment, view mode, a split action.
When not to — unrelated actions (keep separate Buttons with spacing), or switching content panels (use Tabs).

Items overlap-free: only the outer corners keep radius/md, and the inner-facing edge border is dropped so one 1px border sits between items. Give icon-only items an aria-label.
